Shipaton 2026 icons, ranked

All 3,288 app icons from Shipaton 2026, judged blind: no names, no links, one icon at a time. Search for yours.

How it was ranked
  • 23 separate Claude Opus 5.5 judges at max effort, 6,977 judgments in all. Each judge was a fresh session that saw only the image files.
  • Every icon was shown alone, on the same grey background, at the same shape and size, with no name or link.
  • Each icon got a score from 0 to 10 for five things: readable when small, stands out, craft, colour and contrast, one clear idea.
  • Round 1 scored all 3,304 icons once. The best 1,000 then got three more scores from fresh judges, four in all.
  • Every judge also scored the same sample icons, so no single judge's taste decided anything.
  • Not ranked: two images that were not app icons, eleven entries showing another app's icon or Expo's default icon, and three apps entered twice, which count once.
  • The icons come from each app's App Store or Google Play listing, or the team's own upload on Devpost. 🏆 marks the 58 apps that won a Shipaton award.
